items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: "...which uses Fraga on more blues as a chorus."

ctx.x: Dan Melrose always wants to claim everything.

I was crazy enough to give Melrose a non-exclusive license to publish the thing, see. And to get so much on published music he published and on recordings or on performances. And split that on certain. I thought he would push it, but he never had, see. He just sits still when it comes up while Hafer does it. He did. Hafer wrote in the Melrose book, you know, Piano Solos. He put a cockeyed explanation up above there about Sweetheart of Mind, which uses Fraga on more blues as a chorus. Well, I got after him on that…
That's right. I've got that right. I'm going to write...
